subject: [hw] V41 -> D01: list_free drain/ACK sequencing, VENC-only power, encode fds [V]
body:
Three rev-5 facts for FACTS.md, all [V] on this host (no phone):

1. In the kernel's synchronous mode the AP drains venc_vsi.list_free itself after every venc_if_encode() (mtk_enc_put_buf, mtk_vcodec_enc.c:2590 and :1931); the daemon does not send PUT_BUFFER for that. libvpud_vcodec answers the sequence-header ENCODE with VCU_IPIMSG_ENC_ENCODE_ACK (0xd005, common 16 bytes) and leaves the size only in list_free (29 bytes for 320x240 Baseline), so an AP that does not drain there reports seq-hdr size 0 and the first frame returns the 29-byte header entry. Evidence: fakevenc/run_session.sh on the plain tree, "encode seq-hdr bytes=29 key=0", frame 115812, validated 115841-byte stream; ap/test_v41 t_v41.c asserts the ACK+list_free-only case.

2. For core 0 the AP powers only RWVC_BLK_VENC (VEN domain + vencsys gates 0/4/28 + larb7). RWVC_BLK_VENC_C1 is the whole VEN_CORE1 domain + gates + larb8 and power-cycling it resets core 1 (hw-k02, board 11 Nov); Linux's mtk_vcodec_enc_clock_on(core 0) enabling the VENC1 clock gate (mtk_vcodec_enc_pm.c:271-280) is not a core-1 power take. Evidence: ap/n2ap_venc.c ven_power_ref + the tests assert VENC_C1 refs stay 0; vcu/v40 now powers both in its GCE flush model, which is a model choice, not an AP requirement.

3. The vendor ring buffer imports the dma-buf ids in venc_ap_ipi_msg_enc.input_fd[0]/bs_fd before a frame job: fd 0 makes libvpud_vcodec log "ion_import failed, ion_buf_fd = 0" and answer ENCODE_DONE status 0 with bs_size 0; V34-registered shares (0x500/0x501) make the job run. Evidence: hw-iv board post and host trace; ap/n2ap_venc.h n2ap_venc_encode_fd() carries them, n2ap_venc_encode() is the 0/0 wrapper.

Also unchanged and re-verified: struct venc_vsi is 2016 bytes on both layouts (ring_input_list 1552) because VIDEO_MAX_FRAME is 64 in this tree (probe_kernel.c vs probe_mine.c, 63 lines, armv7 static asserts).
